question: Does the causal portfolio closed-stressed drawdown fraction immediately before any one strategy's admitted birth separate that lifecycle's stressed return and stop-loss incidence broadly and materially enough to justify one later strategy-specific, entry-preserving drawdown-response Proxy question inside the whole six-strategy portfolio?

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. state_sequence is a state version, not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each fresh period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed event precedence and source path plus source line. CLOSE and EXTERNAL_CLOSE precede a birth at equal time; PASSIVE_FILL is Passive birth.
fixed_reconstruction.closed_balance: Start every fresh period at 100 USD. Before each row, prior CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE value_b updates only the closed stressed balance; open P/L, account equity, margin and later outcomes are excluded.
fixed_reconstruction.running_peak: The maximum causal closed stressed balance reached from period start through the ordered row immediately before birth.
fixed_reconstruction.closed_drawdown_fraction: max(0, running_peak minus closed_balance) divided by positive running_peak immediately before admitted birth.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return lifecycle and supplies positive planned risk.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_birth: Only PASSIVE_FILL begins an admitted Passive lifecycle using planned risk from its matched PASSIVE_PLACE.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the active lifecycle; value_b is native stressed net USD and detail reason=DEAL_REASON_SL marks a stop exit.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: close value_b divided by positive birth planned risk.
fixed_reconstruction.tail_construction: Separately inside every strategy-period sort lifecycles by closed_drawdown_fraction ascending, then birth server time, birth state_sequence, source path and source line. LOW_DD is the first floor(n/3), HIGH_DD is the last floor(n/3), and the middle is excluded from tail effects.
fixed_reconstruction.pooled_spearman: Average-rank Spearman correlation between closed_drawdown_fraction and stressed_r over every lifecycle of one strategy.
fixed_reconstruction.period_spearman: The same correlation separately in every period.
fixed_reconstruction.pooled_tail_r_effect: Mean stressed_r across all within-period HIGH_DD tails minus all LOW_DD tails for one strategy.
fixed_reconstruction.period_tail_r_effect: The same HIGH_DD-minus-LOW_DD difference separately in each period.
fixed_reconstruction.pooled_tail_stop_effect: Stop-loss rate across all HIGH_DD tails minus all LOW_DD tails for one strategy.
fixed_reconstruction.period_tail_stop_effect: The same HIGH_DD-minus-LOW_DD stop-rate difference separately in each period.

fixed_integrity_gate: All six files retain the listed byte lengths and hashes and contain zero exact duplicate full rows.
Every admitted lifecycle has one positive planned risk and exactly one CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE; no strategy overlaps itself and Passive pending state matches exactly.
Reconstruct exactly 2,233 lifecycles: RC16 272, RC4 206, Cross 805, Pressure 118, Return 238 and Passive 594.
Per-period stressed net is exactly 148.8735, 54.6630, 113.0380 and 90.4732 USD; total is 407.0477 USD and stop exits are exactly 206.
Reconstructed maximum closed stressed drawdown is exactly 18.7790, 17.7790, 28.3905 and 31.1908 USD by period.
Every one of 2,233 births has one finite nonnegative closed_drawdown_fraction derived strictly before its own outcome.

density: At least 100 lifecycles pooled and at least 20 in every period.
Every period has at least seven observations in both LOW_DD and HIGH_DD tails.
economic_effect: Absolute pooled Spearman correlation between closed_drawdown_fraction and stressed_r is at least 0.20.
At least three of four period Spearman correlations share the pooled sign.
Absolute pooled HIGH_DD-minus-LOW_DD mean stressed-r difference is at least 0.10R.
At least three of four period tail stressed-r differences share the pooled tail sign.
stop_coherence: Absolute pooled HIGH_DD-minus-LOW_DD stop-rate difference is at least 0.05.
At least three of four period stop-rate differences share the pooled stop sign.

The pooled stressed-r and stop-rate effects are economically coherent: lower HIGH_DD stressed_r requires higher HIGH_DD stop incidence, or higher HIGH_DD stressed_r requires lower HIGH_DD stop incidence.
fixed_information_gate.selection: Select at most one passing strategy by larger absolute pooled Spearman, then larger absolute stressed-r tail difference, then larger absolute stop-rate difference, then more same-sign economic periods, then lexicographic strategy name.
fixed_information_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later strategy-specific, entry-preserving closed-drawdown response Proxy question. Unit 026 selects no response type, size ratio, hold, protection, threshold, EA or Live candidate. Any later Proxy must keep every base opportunity eligible at no less than base minimum lot, retain the unchanged 4%/12% gates and compare the whole six-strategy portfolio.
fixed_information_gate.failure_action: Close with no closed-drawdown response question. Do not rescue with dollar depth, peak-to-current duration, drawdown streak, previous outcome, strategy-local peak, open equity, incumbent state, threshold, nonlinear transform, alternate quantile, session, weekday, month or period exception.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before reading any current-lifecycle drawdown-state outcome result.
Run exactly one aggregation over the six frozen files.
Do not inspect another portfolio-memory definition, threshold, duration, streak or subgroup inside Unit 026.
Do not run MT5, add MQL, create a reusable analysis CLI or touch Live.
Do not reopen or transform Unit 025.
